what: A 63-runner counterexample to the shifted Lonely Runner Conjecture: the open arcs {t : ||v_i t + s_i|| < 1/64} cover the circle. It is a second, smaller cover for n = 63, the case Xavier Callens settled first (Zenodo 24051700, 2026-11-08); it is not a new case.
structure: Base 2, 4, ..., 128 at shift 0. Remove 8, 32, 96. Rephase 12, 24, 48 to 1/2 + delta/2, 16 to -3 delta/2, 64 to -delta, 128 to +delta. Add 3 and 9 at 3/4. This is Poliakova's 9 -> 8 local rule (arXiv:2609.23952) cut off at 2N = 128 with the top trick: 11 touched speeds, against 18 in Callens's certificate.
